clean_room_boundary.statement: Primary sources motivated the mathematics only. No third-party implementation or construction byte was copied into this lane.

paperclip.usage: The complete Paperclip skill was loaded first. Full text was read directly with line addresses; no Paperclip repository or clipboard mutation was created.

sources.title: Further Improvements to the Lower Bound for an Autoconvolution Inequality
used_claims: High-resolution upsampling can inherit a coarse local maximum.
The first and third autoconvolution objectives exhibit peak locking and rugged nonsmooth surfaces.
sources.scope_limit: The paper's main inequality is nonnegative and different from signed C3; it motivates diagnostics rather than transferring a bound.

sources.title: Unimodular Waveform Design that Minimizes PSL of Ambiguity Function over A Continuous Doppler Frequency Shift Region of Interest
sources.used_claim: A related peak-sidelobe problem can be lifted to an SDP with a rank-one constraint and tightened sequentially.
sources.scope_limit: The retained campaign already tested a coarse SROCR rank lift, so this lane deliberately uses a factor-space Newton system instead.

sources.title: Skip the Hessian, Keep the Rates: Globalized Semismooth Newton with Lazy Hessian Updates
sources.used_claim: Semismooth Newton methods can reuse matrix-free generalized-Hessian information for nonsmooth optimization while retaining fast local convergence.
sources.scope_limit: No convergence theorem is claimed for the nonconvex signed C3 polynomial-square constraint.

exa.usage: Read-only primary-source discovery through the configured Exa CLI; credentials were not printed, logged, or copied.
